answer: I ran the Bell circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The task said "garnet-mock", but the server lists the alias as "garnet:mock", so I used that one. The circuit was H on qubit 0, CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, and a measurement of both qubits. Job 01a15f47-f638-7287-8c14-e0d507612ab7 succeeded. The counts were 00: 30, 11: 26, 01: 24 and 10: 20. These counts come from Qiskit, which writes bitstrings little-endian. The mock returns random results, so the 01 and 10 counts are expected and do not show an entangled state. Mock jobs are free, so no credits were spent. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-298/run_bell.py.
